| **task** | An LLM-powered multi-agent framework with layered memory and distinct trader characters for stock and fund trading decisions. | “We assert that this framework is well-suited for stock and fund trading, where the extraction of highly relevant insights from hierarchical financial data is imperative to inform trading decisions.” |
| **architecture** | Multiple LLM agents, each with short/middle/long-term memory layers ranked by recency, relevancy and importance; daily immediate and extended reflections; risk-preference characters; inter-agent debate on shared stocks; FAISS vector store. | “This represents a pioneering multi-agent trading system that integrates memory streams and debate mechanisms, anchored on LLMs. Building on Park et al.’s weighted memory mechanisms, our system innovatively categorizes the agent’s memories into short-term, middle-term, and long-term layers” |
